name: Reverse Module
detailed_description:
An old school RPG about Utopia/Dystopia balance.

We are in a world with two major cities striving for Utopia.

In the first city, called Visthansia, people can have two microchips on them. One of these microchips doesn't allow people to physically hurt other people and the other one calls the police if they're in trouble. These microchips are not mandatory and you get money for having each one on.

Your journey begins when Aelor, a police student in this city, needs to defeat a memories manipulating creature to graduate. She manages to defeat the creature and passes out.

She wakes up in a village that is stuck in an eternal 3 days time cycle where villagers from the Past, Present and Future appears on different days. Her savior, tells Aelor that she has been infected with a deadly disease where a person presents a mark somewhere on their body and another person presents the exact same mark somewhere on their body as well. The two people have to meet and install a Reverse Module or they will die.

Will you choose the Past, the Present or the Future?

The rest of the game takes place in your chosen time and subsequent playthroughs will be influenced by the choices you made in different times.

short_description: An RPG about how an actual Utopia could be achieved with advanced technology. For example, if you could surgically change your likes and dislikes at will, would you do it? Choose wisely.
